occupied_unwritten.what: rows this lane's CURRENT class occupies that the head's bytes leave at the price base: the class moved under bytes already written, so this lane writes them here for the first time

reverted_to_the_price_base.what: OCCUPIED BY THE HEAD (read from the head's own class vector, not inferred from the prediction), out of this serve's class, and untouched by the bytes file: the stale head is dropped and the row carries the price base

extension.note: a member read from cache did not refit, so it contributes no entry to per_fit; its extension is the one it was fitted with, which the cache NAME keys on

2026-07.what: on the 152,719 rows the 2026-01 head wrote, the distance to what the 2026-07 head would have written there. This is queue's negative control as a NUMBER: rebuild the 2026-07 set's mean from its ten members, restrict to 2026-01, and the candidate must sit this far from it

on the 192,122 rows the 2026-07 head wrote, the distance to what the 2026-01 head would have written there. This is queue's negative control as a NUMBER: rebuild the 2026-01 set's mean from its ten members, restrict to 2026-07, and the candidate must sit this far from it

2026-07.what: the unweighted mean of K ranking-side fits of the shipped recipe on the same K perturbed fit-panels the fold members use -- same seeds, same MOVED counts, same draw order, so the fold price describes the arm that ships. No member was selected

excluded_as_a_superseded_instrument.what: an arm priced against a neighbour block that has since been rebuilt is a reading of a different instrument

arm_choice.rule: largest clean gain among arms with every fold interval clear and the registered tail clause passing on every fold; controls and placebos excluded by name

selection.what_this_means: the chosen arm's interval is the interval of the LARGEST of 14 readings that passed every clause on one and the same three folds, not the interval of a single pre-registered arm. It is quoted with this count beside it and is expected to be optimistic by roughly the spread of the pool. No correction is applied to it, because a correction would be a second choice made on the same data; the count is stated instead.

fold.read_on: the vector that ships: the saved fold-side update this base set names, no refit and no airport held

increment_over_the_head.head_vector_provenance: the vector v18's BYTES ship: the bundle's fit (code/chainbundle.py) on the ungated class at the 28.2 gate, 255 leaves, the frozen p99.5 guard, the floor and LFPG held, at this serve's own pins july 8179f74417c8cb99 / december d35b7171d7062341 / january cb4d6289cb421aa2. It is the head whenever v18 is the base, because v18 is what is on the board (reading 17, 246.3605)

lit_rule.ruling: desk, 2026-09-09, section 26.5: an EMPTY lit fold is not a crossing -- a cell dark by instrument is priced on its lit folds (>= 2, december among them for a winter ranking month). A fold whose interval CROSSES zero is evidence against and still fails

increment_over_the_head.rule_applied: the registered rule: every fold interval clear
increment_over_the_head.the_unselected_reading_is_record_only: desk, 2026-09-09, reversing its own 05:40 ruling after review round 6: the pooled/no-fold-declining reading is recorded beside the gate and never applied as one
increment_over_the_head.what: the increment over the served head: d = d_new - d_head on the with-clock rows, priced against a base of pbase + d_head, with the airport hold applied to BOTH vectors so the comparison is like for like

tail_clause.clause: rows with y > 3600 s not worse by more than 1 s of RMSE (assignments/k2climb.md line 24); tail rule reads it as a secondary guard and not a gate
tail_clause.read_on: the vector that ships (d-seasonal-bag10-255-free.npz), with [] zeroed, no refit

tail_guard.cut_read_from: the pinned panel this serve ships, re-derived at the frozen quantile
tail_guard.why_the_two_differ: the cut is a quantile of the block's own tail, and the ungated class carries rows guard-arms.json's blocks do not; the quantile is unchanged and frozen

population.policy: desk ruling 2026-09-09, standing for both lanes: a delivery enters a fold only at a recorded re-price -- new population file, new arms.json, gate re-read, ledger row. The serve never races the harvest.

ranking.what: the ranking months' population as this serve read it, and the diff against the previous serve's; the ranking months are deliberately UNPINNED (desk, 2026-09-09) so a delivery reaches the served file, and this record is what keeps that visible rather than silent

population.ranking_months_are_not_pinned: the 2026 blocks are rebuilt from whatever the harvest has delivered; no key gates them, which is the ruling's intent -- the served file should read everything delivered

sibling_check.what: this candidate is the sibling plus one named change, checked row by row before the write rather than described

gate.the_wrong_placements_are_inside_the_numb: the gated subset's estimated precision is 0.8958, so about a tenth of the rows carry a fabricated clock; they are inside every fold interval section 28.2 quotes, which is what the desk means by pricing the trade
gate.thresholds_were_fixed_on: the ranking side before any fold was priced: step 0 is the shipped rows' p95 of t_airborne - obs_wheels_off (27.1) and 1,299 s is the shipped rows' p95 of |P - AOBT| (27.3); the cross-fitted pick equals the in-fold pick and the selection premium is zero (28.3)
